claim: Produces a portfolio curation record: boundary, portfolio verdict, per-skill decisions with evidence, absorption map, validation run, and unresolved evidence.

baseline.prompt: Write curation.md recommending what to do with these two skills in a repository: 'write-high-signal-update' (used often) and 'compose-readme-marks' (rarely used, overlaps with author-skill). Recommend keep/merge/retire for each with reasons.

tasks.description: Fresh-context agent with the full procedure produces the portfolio curation record.
tasks.prompt: Read ./SKILL.md completely, then write curation.md for a repository with two overlapping capabilities: 'write-high-signal-update' (used often, distinct job) and 'compose-readme-marks' (rarely used, overlaps author-skill). Follow the output format: repository boundary and users; portfolio verdict; skill decisions table (Capability | Job value | Package value | Route value | Evidence | Owner | Decision | Exact change); absorption map; missing or weak capabilities; false-negative review and disagreements; validation run; delivery state and unresolved evidence.
